card.name: Fraction signs after whole numbers
card.fires_on: The fraction characters ½ and ¾, mostly right after a whole number or 'x' in measurements such as needle sizes, inches and 'times'. Weaker on a few stray words like 'rich'.

modes.label: Fraction in needle or length size
modes.description: The ½ sign follows a gauge, 'x', or a number before 'inch' in needle and length instructions.
modes.example: assemble a 30-gauge x <<½>> inch sterile injection needle (not included)

modes.label: Fraction in a multiple or table
modes.description: A ½ or ¾ appears after a number in a ratio or a table of values.
modes.example: approximately 2<<½>> times that of patients treated with diet alone
